mekayis.metin: (رَسَغَ) الرَّاءُ وَالسِّينُ وَالْغَيْنُ كَلِمَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، [الرُّسْغُ] : وَهُوَ مَوْصِلُ الْكَفِّ فِي الذِّرَاعِ، وَالْقَدَمِ فِي السَّاقِ. وَالرِّسَاغُ: حَبْلٌ يُشَدُّ فِي رُسْغِ الْحِمَارِ، ثُمَّ يُشَدُّ إِلَى وَتَدٍ. وَيُقَالُ أَصَابَ الْمَطَرُ الْأَرْضَ فَرَسَّغَ، وَذَلِكَ إِذَا بَلَغَ الْمَاءُ الرُّسْغَ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: رُسْغ • (rusḡ) m (plural أَرْسَاغ (ʔarsāḡ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: A voiced form of رَسَخَ (rasaḵa, “to be fixed, to sink in”) from the root ر س خ (r s ḵ) or similar, with the rest of the formations within the root ر س غ (r s ḡ) being secondary to the present anatomical term.
g: carpus (amongst humans: wrist, amongst horses: knee or fetlock or whole pastern)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: رَسَّغَ • (rassaḡa) II (non-past يُرَسِّغُ (yurassiḡu), verbal noun تَرْسِيغ (tarsīḡ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: A voiced form of رَسَخَ (rasaḵa, “to be fixed, to sink in”) from the root ر س خ (r s ḵ) or similar, with the rest of the formations within the root ر س غ (r s ḡ) being secondary to the present anatomical term.
g: to rain amply such that the water reaches the wrists of one digs for it
to make easy-going, to coordinate well, to make pass comfortly
